text: I'm so sorry to trouble you at this time of night. My little grandson is 3 and his temperature is 39.5. He's had a runny nose and been sneezing all day, I thought it was just a cold. But I think his breathing has gone very fast now, and I'm not sure if I'm imagining it but there's a sort of grunting noise with some of his breaths and the skin is pulling in under his ribs. I've checked him all over and there's no rash anywhere. Maybe I'm worrying too much but I didn't want to leave it.
